name: Hosts With the Most: USA, Canada and Mexico
angle: The three co-hosts each wrote history at their home World Cup: Mexico became the first Mexican side to win all three group games, Canada thrashed Qatar 6-0 and reached the last 16 for the first time ever, and the USA came through a red card to make the knockouts.
